body.statement: If Open-ended Question \(\mathrm{oeq:uniform\text{-}generated\text{-}residual\text{-}expansion}\) is resolved affirmatively for the class \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\), its joint event \(\mathcal G_n(x;C_m,\widehat m)\), and its constant \(c_u\), there are constants \(c_\ell,c_r,C,C'>0\), depending only on the fixed envelope and kernel bandwidth, such that for the unique \(\widehat m\in\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\), every integer \(n\), \(0<\lambda\le\lambda_0\), and \(0<\alpha\le1/4\), with \(u_{d,\alpha}=\log(8/\alpha)+\log(2d)\), \[n\lambda\ge C\log((d+1)/\alpha)\quad\text{and}\quad r_n^4\le c_r\lambda\] imply both \(u_{d,\alpha}\le c_u n\) and \[\sup_{(P,\theta)\in\mathcal M_d(\lambda)}P^{\otimes n}(\widehat\theta_n(\widehat m)\ne\theta)\le\alpha.\] Consequently, if \(n_0=\lceil C\lambda^{-1}\log((d+1)/\alpha)\rceil\) satisfies \(n_0^{-4\beta/(2\beta+1)}\le c_r\lambda\), then \[c_\ell\frac{\log((d+1)/\alpha)}{\lambda}\le N^*(d,\alpha,\lambda)\le n_0\le C'\frac{\log((d+1)/\alpha)}{\lambda}.\] The lower bound ranges over every measurable procedure on the identical class \(\mathcal M_d(\lambda)\).
body.justification: This is the corrected all-procedure frontier, conditional on one determinate nuisance class and its explicit simultaneous regression guarantee, with the converse proved unconditionally on the same attainable model.
body.gap: Mooij et al. (2016) give pointwise consistency, while ordinary plug-in analysis yields only a slower nuisance-limited sufficient rate; no cited result matches upper and lower exact-recovery bounds for supplied independent ANM pairs.
body.consumer: Practitioners receive a sample-size rule for familywise orientation of many independent scientific cause--effect modules.
